plateau_rule: After at least 4 N levels, first of latest 3 points whose next 2 doublings improve neither P/all-accesses nor P/N-misses by more than 0.5 percentage points.
match_rule: First tested N-only mean QPS >= selected NMD mean; refine bracket up to 3 times. Observed finite-workload crossing, not a proof of global minimal memory.
memory: RSS after_search minus RSS after_load; includes all additional resident allocations, excludes common PQ/index and SSD D payload
nonly_search_revision: After NMD selection, bracket starting at 65,536 nodes; double if needed, then 3 single-run bisections and two-run boundary confirmation. Chosen before observing any cached N-only result to avoid unnecessary tiny-capacity runs.
